For further details contact us at https://mythospedals.com/pages/contact Mjolnir Differences We make a lot of different Mjolnirs! Learn more about the differences on our FAQ Page . An exclusive Mjolnir for Mass Street Music. This features a different layout and NOS USA Mil Spec Germanium diodes that sound fantastic. The diode pair in a Mjolnir circuit is crucial and these Germanium diodes impart a smooth/compressed feel and lovely breakup. It's softer and less focused than the standard version. The circuit otherwise is similar to the standard Mjolnir. Less mids and treble than your standard Klone so it more friendly to every player out there. These do not have a charge pump so they honestly preform better as an overdrive and stack beautifully. One of our favorites.
